title: KPMG Tax Technology Bite LIVE!
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
Join Vertex at Tax Technology Bite LIVE! hosted by KPMG Meijburg & Co, to explore how AI, automation, data, and emerging technologies are transforming today's tax function.


This full-day event brings together tax, finance, and technology professionals to discuss the strategies, innovations, and practical solutions shaping the future of tax.


Through thought leadership sessions, interactive discussions, and live technology demonstrations, you'll gain valuable insights into key topics including AI in tax, e-invoicing and real-time compliance, tax technology strategy, data management, and analytics. Connect with industry experts and peers while discovering how leading organisations are leveraging technology to improve efficiency, manage risk, and unlock greater strategic value from their tax operations.


Visit Vertex at the Technology Market to learn how modern tax technology can help your organisation navigate digital transformation and stay ahead in an increasingly data-driven regulatory environment. Register today to secure your place
